index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents a hierarchical taxonomy of classification criteria for adversarial attacks, structured as a top-down flowchart. At the top center, a dark blue rectangular box labeled 'Classification Criteria' serves as the root node. From this central node, eight primary branches extend horizontally downward, each leading to a distinct category represented by a dark blue rounded rectangle with white text, all aligned within a light blue horizontal band. These categories are: Life-Cycle, Target, Data Type, Purpose, Knowledge, Control, C.I.A., and Strategy.

Each primary category further branches vertically into subcategories, displayed as dark blue rounded rectangles with white text, grouped under light beige rectangular backgrounds to visually cluster related items. The connections between nodes are indicated by solid black lines with arrowheads pointing from parent to child nodes, signifying hierarchical relationships.

Under 'Life-Cycle', the subcategories listed vertically are: Pre-training, Training, Post-training, Deployment, and Inference. Under 'Target', the subcategories are: Targeted and Non-targeted. Under 'Data Type', the subcategories include: Image, Text, Audio, Tabular, Graph, Cybersecurity, and Multimodal. Under 'Purpose', the subcategories are: Evasion, Jailbreak, Prompt injection, Poisoning, Inference, and Model Stealing. Under 'Knowledge', the subcategories are: White-box, Grey-box, and Black-box. Under 'Control', the subcategories are: Training data, Testing data, Model, Source Code, Queries, and Label Limit. Under 'C.I.A.', the subcategories are: Availability Breakdown, Integrity Violations, and Privacy Compromise. Finally, under 'Strategy', the subcategories are: Passive and Active.

All text is rendered in a clean sans-serif font, with consistent alignment and spacing across the diagram. The color scheme uses dark blue for all nodes, light beige for grouping backgrounds, and light blue for the main category band, ensuring visual clarity and distinction between levels. The overall layout is symmetrical and balanced, facilitating easy comprehension of the multi-dimensional classification framework for adversarial attacks.
